verdict: The paper is a solid ISCAS component-paper Accept but not a Strong Accept. M2047 supplies exact post-load VCS cycles on four fixed performance-independent ep34 G48 groups, and M2030 separately supplies a matched logic-only DC ablation on the exact same parametric RTL source. The paper keeps these facts scoped and does not infer full-FC, whole-network, same-area, macro-inclusive, hold-closed, power, or energy claims.

selection_boundary.rule: first captured sample of each of four sealed ep34 DSEC sequences; layer 28; first G48 FC1 service; tokens 0..3
selection_boundary.weights: deterministic signed INT8 directed weights; not captured model weights; schedule is weight-value independent

same_source_axis.only_static_mode_difference: SCHEDULE_MODE=0 token-major versus SCHEDULE_MODE=1 source-group-major ordering and matching row-clear index

P1: M2047 covers four G48 groups from one FC1 layer and four token contexts, not full-FC or cross-layer generality.
The C2/TSBG physical anchor is logic-only; hold, SRAM macros, and power are open.
C1's 1.6945x remains a cycle-model ratio with a separate mapped physical anchor rather than one workload closing model, RTL throughput, and physical implementation.
P2: The real measured interval contains no natural negative source code; signed and minus-128 behavior is separately synthetic and correctly disclosed.
The directed INT8 weights are not captured real weights; this is acceptable only while the schedule remains weight-value independent and the distinction remains explicit.
Commit the paper worktree and exclude submission debris before release; this is operational hygiene, not a scientific blocker.

strong_accept_gate: Broaden the same predeclared M2047 procedure to a fixed population spanning more FC1/FC2 layers and token groups and report its distribution; the next highest-value closure is matched macro-aware hold-closed power. Neither is required for the current honest ISCAS Accept submission.
